The '''ILF-5500''' was a model of [[Life-form scanner/Legends|lifeform scanner]] manufactured by [[Idellian Arrays/Legends|Idellian Arrays]]. It was capable of detecting the quantity and [[Species/Legends|species]] of any lifeforms within its scanning range. The ILF-5500 was also capable of storing "species templates" of up to ten different aliens or creatures, allowing the operator to determine if specific species were present extremely quickly.<ref name="ROE" />
